messages.subject: Saving class profiles back to original dataframe
parts:
Hello!

I have the results of my LPA and have used 

get_data(lpa4) %>% filter(Class_prob == 1)

to get the class per each ID variable. However, I'm unclear how to add this back into my dataframe. Is the dataframe per row ID, in which case I can just cbind? I'm always wary of using cbind to merge dataframes and would love to use my own ID variable in the LPA analysis so I can left_join(by = "IDVariable"). 

Is this possible? Or can I trust cbind to do what I want?

Thanks,
Dana
